stories.headline: Two giant pandas arrive at Zoo Atlanta
stories.summary: Two giant pandas, the male Ping Ping and the female Fu Shuang, have arrived at the zoo in Atlanta. They come under an agreement signed between the United States and China, which the zoo announced in April. Zoo Atlanta housed giant pandas from 1999 to 2024, one of only four institutions in the United States to do so.

stories.headline: A course record at the Berlin Marathon
stories.summary: The 52nd Berlin Marathon was run on Sunday. Tigst Assefa of Ethiopia won the women's race in 2:11:04, a course record and the third best marathon time ever run, after an injury left her limping over the final two kilometres. Guye Adola, the 2021 champion in Berlin, took the men's race with a personal best.

stories.headline: Munich will carry Germany's Olympic bid
stories.summary: Germany's Olympic committee has picked Munich as the city it will put forward to host the Summer Olympics and Paralympics in 2036, 2040 or 2044. Munich won the vote by 91 to 50 over the Rhine-Ruhr region. The city had already held a referendum in October 2025, in which 66.4% of those voting said yes.

stories.headline: Burnt scrolls and a hunt for lead in ancient ink
stories.summary: Researchers burned their own papyrus scrolls in a furnace to learn how to read the ones charred when Mount Vesuvius erupted in 79 C.E. They found that lead in the ink absorbed as much as 25 times more X-rays than the burned papyrus around it, which made the writing stand out on a scan. About 1,800 scrolls and fragments from that library survive today, in collections in Italy, France and England.
